quotes.name: Sammie Alvarez
quotes.quote: To be honest, I've been feeling a bit uncertain about my role as a Civic & Neighborhood Reporter lately. I've seen a lot of energy in Temescal, people caring about improving the neighborhood, but it doesn't seem to be translating into action. I'm not sure how people perceive me or my reporting, but I feel like I'm just trying to capture the essence of what's going on around here.

quotes.name: Rafael Phillips
quotes.quote: To be honest, money's been tight lately. I've been managing, but it's a hard squeeze. My routine as a nurse aide is what keeps me going.

quotes.name: Iris Pham
quotes.quote: I've had one episode this cycle, and it looks like my credits went up by 1. I'm not sure how it impacted them exactly, but I guess it's a positive change.
